semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Chiyoda Optical Instruments specializes in high-end optical microscopy and machine vision lenses, which are relevant for semiconductor inspection and measurement processes.
summary: Chiyoda Optical Instruments provides advanced optical solutions, including microscope and machine vision lenses, suitable for high-resolution imaging in semiconductor applications. Their products support a range of wavelengths and are designed for both prototyping and mass production.
capabilities: High-end microscope objective lens units with infinity-corrected optical systems
Coaxial reflected light illumination for high-resolution imaging
Compatibility with 1.1" sensor sizes and image circles up to φ20 mm
Support for visible light to short-wave infrared (SWIR) applications
